title: mihrab-methods correction list
description: A method's correction list: the few times its authority's own program puts on the other side of a minute's rounding point. Each entry moves one printed time of one point on one date by a minute. Published at data/corrections/<authority>.json; certification.json names the list in force (its dates, its size and its SHA-256).

from.description: The first date the list was made over.

to.description: The last date the list was made over; past it the method alone applies.

points.description: The point the method is computed at, as 'lat,lon' to three decimals → its corrections.

items.description: 'YYYY-MM-DD prayer ±1': the minutes to add to that prayer's printed time on that date.
